item.title: Bulletin updated at 04:50 HKT 08/Jun/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A trough of low pressure will linger over the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days and will bring heavy showers and squally thunderstorms to the region. Under the influence of the southwest monsoon, there will still be showers over Guangdong during the weekend. With the anticyclone aloft over the western North Pacific extending westwards, showers will lessen slightly over the coast of Guangdong early next week.

Date/Month: 08/06 (Wednesday)

Weather: Cloudy with showers and squally thunderstorms. Showers will be heavy at times.
Temp range: 25 - 29 C
R.H. range: 80 - 95 per Cent
PSR: High
